600 To 36,000 Filmmakers: How IFP Was Built | Cyrus Says
Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, Ritam Bhatnagar, Founder of IFP, joins Cyrus Broacha to talk about building a creative platform that brings together filmmakers, musicians, writers, designers and artists.
Ritam talks about his early dreams of becoming a scientist, his unexpected journey through an MBA, starting a film club in Ahmedabad and taking cinema to rural India in a truck. He also shares how a monsoon break led to IFP’s 50-hour filmmaking challenge, which grew from 600 participants to 36,000 filmmakers.
